business_summary: Ogura Clutch Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells clutch brakes for the general industry in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Transportation Equipment business and General Industrial Business segments. It offers clutch brakes, such as for office machines, machine tools, construction and industrial machinery, etc; fiber tensioner, tension control system, automotive A/C clutches, roots blower (Supercharger), power clutches, oil mist separators, high-pressure coolant systems, disaster prevention systems, etc. The company also provides solenoids for powertrains, racing clutch, as well as PTO clutches for riding, zero turn, and commercial walk-behind mowers. Its products are used in office equipment, machine tools, construction machinery, industrial machinery, and car air conditioners. The company was formerly known as Ogura Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ogura Clutch Co.,Ltd. in May 1961. Ogura Clutch Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Kiryu, Japan.
